name: GameSir Tarantula 8K

modes.connection: USB (cable or 2.4 GHz receiver: both enumerate as USB, so the link type was not determined)
modes.verification: Observed 2026-10-27 on Windows 11 Pro 26200 with the StickyAim CLI: enumerates as 'Xbox 360 Controller for Windows' (xusb22, XInput slot 0), HID interfaces IG_00 (gamepad, XInput HID view) and MI_01 (consumer control + vendor page 0xFFF0). Untouched sticks produced 7576 state changes/s via XInput and 7576 HID reports/s via Raw Input (mean interval 132 us, p50 124.5 us) over 5 s.

notes: At rest the sticks jitter by about +/-20 raw counts (sd ~0.0002 normalized) on every report, so XInput's packet number advances continuously even when the controller is untouched. This is why the measured state-change rate is close to the report rate at rest.
Measured rest offsets on the test unit: right stick |v| ~0.015, left stick ~0.031. Re-measure your own unit with Stick Lab > Rest calibration.
MI_01 exposes a vendor-defined collection (usage page 0xFFF0). StickyAim never writes to it; it is presumably the channel used by GameSir's own configuration software.
unverified: Product IDs for other modes (Switch, DirectInput/Android, Bluetooth, 2.4 GHz dongle) are not in this file because they were not observed.
